# Mac shortcuts in the windows of tests\external\two-windows.ps1:
#
#   dist\KeyFlip.Tests.exe --external "KeyFlip check A" tests\external\mac-shortcuts.txt
#
# With --installed the same keys go through the copy of KeyFlip that is running; turn
# its Mac shortcuts on first, and convert with Win rather than Alt.
mac-shortcuts:on
# A lone Alt must not be the conversion gesture here.
tap-key:win
layout:en

# Moving and selecting.
type:one two three
key:alt+left
type:X
expect:Xone two three
key:alt+right
type:Y
expect:Xone two threeY
key:win+left
type:Z
expect:Xone two ZthreeY
key:alt+shift+left
type:W
expect:WthreeY

# Deleting to the start and to the end of the line; the start and the end of the text.
key:alt+right
key:enter
type:second line here
key:win+left
key:alt+backspace
expect:WthreeY\nhere
key:alt+up
key:alt+delete
expect:\nhere
key:alt+down
type: again
expect:\nhere again
key:win+shift+left
type:there
expect:\nhere there

# A lone Alt opens no menu, and Alt+Shift does not change the input language.
key:alt
key:alt+shift
type:w
expect:\nhere therew
expect-layout:en

# The next window of the same program, and back.
key:alt+`
front:KeyFlip check B
type:b
expect:b
key:alt+`
front:KeyFlip check A
expect:\nhere therew
key:alt+shift+`
front:KeyFlip check B
key:alt+m
minimized:KeyFlip check B

# Quit: Alt+Q closes the window, which Windows brought forward when the other one
# was minimized.
front:KeyFlip check A
key:alt+q
gone
